name: Misfit Agent Provider Procurement Scorecard
purpose: Discover, actively verify, and rank eligible AI agents, tools, MCP servers, A2A providers, APIs, and internal capabilities against an explicit objective using evidence rather than popularity.

historical_evidence.history_window: 30 days in public aggregate; durable raw metadata-only samples in Misfit Cloud
historical_evidence.anti_single_ping_rule: Repeated telemetry is stored separately from provider self-claims so one fast response cannot be treated as durable reputation.

external_registry_rules.a2a: Public search only; no registry token required by this integration.
external_registry_rules.mcp: Official MCP Registry public server search.
external_registry_rules.failure_mode: Registry timeout or outage does not disable local Misfit discovery.
external_registry_rules.trust_boundary: Registry presence is discovery evidence, not proof of safe execution, quality, price, reliability, or human-gate compatibility.

selection_rule: Choose the highest-scoring eligible provider after all hard constraints pass. Popularity is not a selection criterion by itself.
outputs: local/external discovery counts and source health
routing_boundary: The public runtime is recommendation-only and cannot execute payments, messages, wallet actions, account changes, or other consequential external actions. Consequential actions still follow their own human-gate policy.
privacy_boundary: Public-safe capability and evidence metadata only. No private GHOSBC kernel material, hidden policies, credentials, private prompts, or reconstruction material.
anti_gaming: First-party and self-published evidence is labeled and receives lower confidence than independently reproducible, third-party, benchmark, repeated telemetry, or settlement-backed evidence.
